page.layout: One column of running text, with the running head and page number at the top. No margin notes and no catchword. The final line "non." is set flush right, as the end of the text.

main_text.p: confuetudo, in quantum vix unquam aut perrarò, talis incidit casus, ut non aliquâ in parte occisor moderamen excessisse deprehendatur. test.Christ. in decis. all. Si tamen manifestissimis probationibus occisor docere sit paratus, se moderamen inculpatæ tutelæ servasse, cur expectari debeat amicorum occisi consensus, nullus video.

Ut qui juri publico suâ pertinaciâ, adeoq; Innocentiæ causæ præjudicium facere nec possint, nec debeant. Cum defensor propriæ salutis in nullo peccasse sit dicendus. l. 45. §. 4. D Ad l. Aquil. l. 131. D. de Verb. signif. l. 3. Cod. Ad l. Corn. de Sicar.
An non tamen in expensas in occisum factas, dum forte eum læthaliter vulneratum curare attentant, occisor esset condemnandus? Resp. Quòd non.

page.notes: The text is printed with the long s, which I have transcribed as plain s throughout. The word "se" before "moderamen" is followed by a printed mark, which I have read as a word break and written as "se moderamen". The line "non." is set flush right and is part of the answer, not a catchword. The page number "383" is printed as "38 3" with a gap, and the running head is "De Duellis." followed by the page number on the same line. The faint watermark at the bottom right and the vertical line at the left edge are not printed text and are omitted.
